annotations.title: Get Dilution Pressure Score and Risk Levels

description: Dilution pressure score: 0-100 with a seven-component breakdown (shelf capacity, ATM/equity-line capacity, warrants in the money, convertible proximity, cash burn urgency, historical dilution, toxic financing), plus four risk levels: overall, offering ability, overhead supply, cash need. Score: components whose inputs could not be measured are dropped from the denominator, so `score` is out of `scoreMaxMeasured`, not out of 100 (58 may be 58 out of 85), and `scoreUnmeasuredComponents` names the excluded components. A low numerator over a reduced denominator is not a low-risk reading. `scoreDenominatorThin: true` (under 70 measured points) marks a partial reading (N of M measured). A non-null `scoreWithheldReason` (e.g. `no_dilution_snapshot`) means there is no score, not a score of zero. With no filed share count, the share-count and market-cap components rest on `details.sharesOutstandingEstimate` {shares, kind, asOf, source}, and `details.marketCapSource` is `"derived_price_x_estimated_os"`: those components rest on an estimate. Levels: when `levelsAreLowerBound` (always present) is true, the levels named in `levelsLowerBoundScope` are a lower bound (floors), not measurements: "medium" means at least medium. Levels outside that scope are measured. `levelsLowerBoundReason` determines which levels are floored: `unquantified_live_instruments` floors overall and overheadSupply; `offering_capacity_unknown` and `market_cap_unmeasured` floor overall and offeringAbility, not `overheadSupply`; `os_growth_span_short`, `os_growth_issuance_floor` and `os_growth_rebased_partial` floor historical and overall; `overhead_capacity_unquantified` floors overheadSupply and overall. `details.levelBounds` per level: `floor` (unsized instruments at zero), `ceiling` (at filed maximum; null when some instrument has none), `exact`, `bestEstimate`, `estimated`, `estimateBasis`. An estimated level is a best estimate between its floor and ceiling, not a measurement. A null `overall` with a non-null `levelsWithheldReason` is withheld, not low. `offeringAbility` is a capability profile, not pressure today: a live ATM or equity line with a measured $0 drawable (e.g. clamped by the I.B.6 cap) reads medium while the score prices the $0, and it does not mean the company cannot raise. `atmRemainingBasis` / `elocRemainingBasis` values `total_minus_reported_sales` and `total_no_sales_reported` mark "up to" figures. `overheadSupply` is potential dilution excluding shelf as a % of shares outstanding: warrants, convertibles and preferred at gross counts, plus live ATM remaining (baby-shelf clamped) and equity-line remaining at the current price, plus live S-1 shares, plus `details.registeredResaleOverhangShares`. Low up to 20%, Medium 20-50%, High over 50%. `details.overheadSupplyBasis` itemises the components (null = not measured) and `unquantified`; it is not the treasury-netted `inTheMoneySupplyPct` / `totalDilutiveShares`. When `details.osGrowthRate` is null, `details.osGrowthFacts` {fromShares, fromDate, toShares, toDate, splitsInWindow, basis} is a fact, not a rating; with `basis: "as_filed"` the two counts are on different split bases and are not a growth comparison. Returns HTTP 200 for unavailable data; the `available` and `reason` fields say why. `not_covered` means this company has not been analysed yet, not that it has no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. A null, absent or withheld value means the figure was not measured; it does not mean "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a measured zero, so availability is carried by the availability, withheld and reason fields, not by the value. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` (a stale date predates anything filed since). Share counts are on one split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted rather than published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).
